neighbours.label: the token ' infinity': a lexical unit for the word itself, related words (infinite, endless, unbounded) stay low
fire: As n goes to infinity, the series converges to two.
The integral is taken from zero to infinity.
Her love for the sea seemed to stretch to infinity.
The movie poster promised adventure to infinity and beyond.
Dividing by a number close to zero sends the result toward infinity.
The artist painted a loop that suggests infinity.
Philosophers have long debated whether an actual infinity can exist.
In floating point, overflow produces a value of infinity.
quiet: As n grows larger, the series converges to two.
The integral is taken from zero to one.
Her love for the sea seemed endless.
The movie poster promised adventure across the galaxy.
Dividing by a number close to zero gives a huge result.
The artist painted a loop that suggests eternity.
Philosophers have long debated whether infinite sets can exist.
In floating point, overflow produces a special value.
